title: Sliding-Window Streaming VLM Smoke Test — Qwen3.8-27B vs Muse Glimmer 30B
summary: Two offline VLMs wrapped as causal online assistants (8-frame sliding visual window + self-generated recurrent text memory, media-time replay) on five randomly sampled items from each of Ego-MC-Bench, Wearable AI, StreamingBench, OVO-Bench and ProactiveVideoQA. All 50 trajectories ran end to end; official or adapted scores where no LLM judge is needed.

title: Human–Device Simulation — a rigged human operating a microwave and a desktop printer (3D render + MuJoCo contact)
summary: Reproducible 3D pipeline: a clothed MPFB human with IK-driven hands operates a CC BY 4.0 microwave model and a generic desktop printer in Blender; each device's key (microwave START, printer OK) is driven by MuJoCo contact against a kinematic fingertip proxy with a negative control; door, knob, bowl, paper tray and paper stack use labelled assisted grasps; the turntable, interior light, display and printed sheet are labelled motor or illustrative effects. Two recorded runs (microwave 51 s, printer 35 s) rendered from external, first-person and hand-detail cameras (preview quality). 2026-10-09: a procedural Samsung-style microwave (21 contact-tested membrane keys, jog dial, hinged door, turntable) replaces the RoboCasa model for new sequences; the old microwave runs stay on the page.
